## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `./scripts/build.sh` and the build succeeded
- [ ] I loaded the extension via `about:debugging` and tested it against a real Pi-hole v6 instance
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` under the appropriate section
- [ ] If I added new UI strings, I added them to **both** `_locales/en` and `_locales/de`
- [ ] If I added a new heuristic pattern, I noted why and where I saw it blocked
